I5.quote: Due to the suitable possibility of the hydrogen storage applications in the liquid organic hydrogen carriers (LOHCs), a systematic analysis of the chemisorption pathway of hydrogen on N–ethylcarbazole doped fullerene (NEC@C60) is given.

notes: Computational paper. Supporting passages: (a) main, p. 6 of 29, Computational Details: "All structures of the reactants, intermediates, transition states, and products involved in this study, were fully optimized in the gas phase using the hybrid density functional theory, B3LYP and 6-31G(d) basis set as implement in Gaussian09 package." (b) main, p. 7 of 29: "which we have identified as well-suited for computational study." (c) main, p. 25 of 29, Conclusion: "The gravimetric storage of NEC@C60 is about 1.5-2 wt% which is less than the gravimetric storage on NEC (more than 5.5 wt%)." This 1.5-2 wt% is a stated capacity with no measurement, sample, instrument or isotherm in the paper, and the NEC figure is quoted from other work. Comparisons with 'the experimental data of Eblagon et al.' (main, p. 9 of 29) are literature values used to compare calculated activation parameters, not the paper's own uptake measurements. Table 2 and Figure 2 use 'experimental conditions (150 C and 7 MPa)' as calculation settings. The SI (si1) holds only geometry, NBO, charge and electron configuration tables and figures of calculated structures. is_retracted is false in record.json and nothing in the text says the article is retracted. Not a review, thesis, patent or abstract: it is a full research article (accepted manuscript). The paper does not say its uptake values were published before. Text is in English. I2 to I4 not assessed because I1 is not met.
